history.name: DhaliwalX/fotufilm-engine
history.summary: Speeds up opening library photos, supports folder-wide photo strips and multi-photo preset editing, and fixes repeating grain patches. Linux app and Resolve plugin remain alpha.
changes: Speeds up opening library photos, supports folder-wide photo strips and multi-photo preset editing, and fixes repeating grain patches. Linux app and Resolve plugin remain alpha.

history.name: DhaliwalX/fotufilm-engine
history.summary: Adds Lab Scan finishing controls, blends film-grain patches to remove grid seams and provides a Linux alpha build.
changes: Adds Lab Scan finishing controls, blends film-grain patches to remove grid seams and provides a Linux alpha build.

history.name: DhaliwalX/fotufilm-engine
history.summary: Adds negative scanning controls and closer Fujifilm slide-film rendering for the Mac app and Resolve plugins.
changes: Adds tone, straighten, frame and light-frame controls for scanned negatives.
Improves Fujifilm slide-film colour rendering; Final Cut Pro lens flare follows the selected stage.

history.name: DhaliwalX/fotufilm-engine
history.summary: Revises cinema-print timing, source illumination and channel contrast behavior. Existing edits may render differently.
changes: Corrects print-layer sensitivity and density targets.
Defaults source illumination to Stock Native, with daylight, tungsten and custom choices.
Separates source light, viewing illumination and print development.
Makes Channel Contrast Match optional and off by default while preserving saved nonzero settings.

history.summary: Improved film rendering, editing controls, and performance.  For Apple silicon Macs with macOS 14 or later. Download the installer for the Mac app and DaVinci Resolve and Final Cut Pro plugins.
